anchors.why: Single concept image the owner sent on 22 Nov 2026: 'make it like this'.
Gift tiles go to a vertical column on the right; the game rules stay those of Şeytan Avı.

departures: Gift tiles: right vertical column instead of the reference's bottom row (owner request).
Crowd sits higher than in the image (design y ~1050-1300, not 1320-1600): below y 1340 TikTok's chat covers the frame.
HP bar stays below TikTok's header (y > 230); the image puts it at y ~240.
Tile texts in the image are garbled (generated); our real tiers and costs are shown.
No pause button: a TikTok stream has no viewer input for it.
Avatar medallions only above figures that are playing right now (the image shows the crowd from behind with no faces).

sky.role: deep blue-violet night, fully saturated, brighter than black

paving_near.role: periwinkle stone, the largest area; cooler and darker towards the camera

fire.role: the devil's fire and ember ring

devil.role: hero red, the most saturated large mass, centre of frame

torii.role: red gate at the far end of the path

identity.devil: Red muscular horned devil (big curved ivory horns, dark mask band over the eyes, grin), lower body of fire, standing in a ring of stones with embers.
identity.crowd: Many identical small hooded figures in navy robes with gold trim, seen from behind, gathered in front of the devil with faint gold rings on the ground.
identity.setting: Japanese shrine courtyard at night: long stone path to a red torii on stairs, two-storey wooden buildings with warm windows on both sides, cherry trees, stone lanterns (toro) along the path, black iron street lamps in front, low stone fences.

materials: Soft stylised shading, smooth rounded forms, no hard outlines, glowing emissive lanterns with bloom, light grain-free surfaces.
lighting: Cool blue-violet ambient, bright enough that every object reads; many warm point sources (lanterns, windows, fire); the devil lit warm from his own fire.

camera.angle: raised, looking down the path (~30 degrees)
camera.subject: devil ~1/5 of frame height, upper middle; crowd in the lower third
camera.horizon: off the top; the torii and roofs close the top of the frame

ui.panels: rounded navy panels with a thin gold border and soft drop shadow
ui.layout: TUR chip top-left with session icons, timer pill top-right, 'ŞEYTAN' with gold diamonds on the left, red HP bar to its right, 'EN ÇOK TAŞ ATANLAR' board under it with crowns, status as a red ribbon above the devil, gift tiles in a right column with numbered gold badges; the top tier glows gold

motion: Calm: the devil holds poses for several seconds; pebbles are small and quick; gifts get big readable moments; cherry petals drift.
nonnegotiables: Red horned devil in a glowing stone ring at the centre of a lavender-blue stone courtyard
Pink sakura and warm lanterns framing both sides, red torii at the far end
Navy hooded crowd with gold trim in front of the devil
Navy + gold HUD panels; gift tiles in a vertical right column
